KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. pana

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

3. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.
